after.zh: 你看到的每一张图，都只是一格一格的数字。把鼠标停在任意一格上，看看它是多少。
after.en: Every image you see is just a grid of numbers, cell by cell. Hover over any cell to see its value.

t.zh: 相机拍下的照片，在电脑里不是一幅画，而是一张数字表：画面切成许多小方格，叫像素，每格记一个亮度。这个游戏里 0 是黑，1 是白，中间是深浅不同的灰。
t.en: Inside a computer, a photo is not a picture but a table of numbers: the image is cut into many small squares called pixels, and each one records a brightness. In this game 0 is black, 1 is white, and in between are shades of grey.

t.zh: 计算机视觉做的事，就是从这张数字表里算出有用的信息：哪里有边、画面里有没有人、东西离多远。这门课里的每个方法，说到底都是对这些数字做运算。
t.en: Computer vision works out useful information from this table of numbers: where the edges are, whether there is a person in the picture, how far away things are. Every method in this course comes down to arithmetic on these numbers.

t.zh: 这一关先熟悉工作台：「输入」是相机给的图，「输出」是你交出去的图，中间用线连起元件，就是电路。每组测试都拿你的输出和期望逐格比对。
t.en: This level gets you used to the workbench: "Input" is the image from the camera, "Output" is the image you hand in, and the parts you wire up in between form a circuit. Each test compares your output with the expected one, cell by cell.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：输入和期望

brief.en: Connect the input to the output.

hint.zh: 从「输入」元件右边的圆点按住，拖到「输出」元件左边的圆点。
hint.en: Press on the dot on the right of the "Input" part and drag it to the dot on the left of the "Output" part.
